# pidginhost_server (Resource)

A cloud server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_ssh_key" "admin" {
  alias = "admin"
  key   = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}

resource "pidginhost_server" "web" {
  hostname       = "web1"
  image          = "ubuntu-24-04"
  package        = "cloudv-1"
  ssh_pub_key_id = pidginhost_ssh_key.admin.id
  new_ipv4       = true

  fw_policy_in  = "DROP"
  fw_policy_out = "ACCEPT"

  destroy_public_ipv4 = true

  timeouts {
    create = "60m"
  }
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = pidginhost_server.web.ipv4_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Operating system image slug, from the pidginhost_images data source. Changing it replaces the server.
- `package` (String) Server package slug, from the pidginhost_packages data source. Changing it resizes the server in place; the API refuses packages with a smaller disk.

### Optional

- `destroy_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to delete the server while true. Set it to false and apply before destroying.
- `destroy_public_ipv4` (Boolean) Release the server's IPv4 addresses when it is destroyed. When false they stay on the account, unattached and billed.
- `destroy_public_ipv6` (Boolean) Release the server's IPv6 addresses when it is destroyed. When false they stay on the account, unattached and billed.
- `enable_ha` (Boolean) Restart and move the server automatically when its host fails. Changing it replaces the server.
- `fw_policy_in` (String) Default firewall policy for incoming traffic: ACCEPT, DROP or REJECT.
- `fw_policy_out` (String) Default firewall policy for outgoing traffic: ACCEPT, DROP or REJECT.
- `fw_rules_set` (String) Name of the firewall rule set applied to the public interface, for example pidginhost_firewall.web.name. An empty string removes it. Some packages, such as the free tier, keep their own firewall.
- `generation` (String) Hardware generation slug. The API picks the default when left empty. Changing it replaces the server.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname. The API picks one when left empty. Changing it replaces the server.
- `new_ipv4` (Boolean) Allocate a new IPv4 address and attach it before first boot. Changing it replaces the server.
- `new_ipv6` (Boolean) Allocate a new IPv6 address and attach it before first boot. Changing it replaces the server.
- `no_network_acknowledged` (Boolean) Confirm creating a server without a public address. Changing it replaces the server.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the default user. Changing it resets the password through cloud-init. Unavailable on servers with a custom OS.
- `private_address` (String) Address in private_network. The API assigns one when left empty. Changing it replaces the server.
- `private_network` (String) Id or address (CIDR) of a private network to join at creation. Changing it replaces the server.
- `project` (String) Project label.
- `public_ip` (String) Id or address of an IPv4 address on the account to attach at creation. Changing it replaces the server.
- `public_ipv6` (String) Id or address of an IPv6 address on the account to attach at creation. Changing it replaces the server.
- `ssh_pub_key` (String) Public key installed for SSH login. Changing it regenerates cloud-init and reboots a running server. An empty string removes it from future cloud-init data but does not revoke keys already in the guest.
- `ssh_pub_key_id` (String) Id or fingerprint of an SSH key stored on the account, installed at creation. Changing it replaces the server.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Startup script run on first boot: an executable script with a shebang. The API stores it in cleartext. Changing it replaces the server.

### Read-Only

- `cpus` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.
- `disk_size` (Number) Disk size in GiB.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object in the PidginHost API.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4 address, if any.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address, if any.
- `memory` (Number) Memory in GiB.
- `status` (String) Status reported by the API, for example active.
- `username` (String) Default user for SSH login.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a server by its numeric id.
terraform import pidginhost_server.web 12345
```
